epk.tooltipSetDuration: Length of the live performance, not including soundcheck or equipment setup.
epk.tooltipSetup: Time needed to install and connect all equipment before the show (PA setup, instruments, lights).
epk.tooltipOwnPa: PA = Public Address. The artist brings their own amplification and speaker system. The venue doesn't need to provide sound.
epk.tooltipOwnLighting: The artist brings their own stage lighting system. The venue doesn't need to provide show lighting.
epk.tooltipFullBackline: The artist brings all their amps and instruments. Backline = onstage musical gear (amps, drums, DI boxes).
epk.scoreLevelProfessionalDesc: Complete profile, ready for any opportunity
epk.scoreLevelSolidDesc: Ready for booking, you can still improve it
epk.scoreLevelProgressDesc: Good progress, add more to stand out
epk.scoreLevelBasicDesc: Just the essentials, missing key info for bookers
epk.bioWhy: The short bio is the first thing a booker reads. In 280 characters you have to convince them.
epk.bioB1: Say who you are, what you play, and what makes you unique
epk.bioB2: Write it in third person, like a presentation
epk.bioShortPh: Alternative rock trio formed in Mexico City in 2019. Influenced by…
epk.bioShortHint: Appears on the main EPK view and in the PDF.
epk.bioLongHint: For bookers who want to dig deeper. Optional but recommended.
epk.contactWhy: The booking email is the single most important field for turning visits into contracts. It's the front door.
epk.contactB1: Use an email you check frequently
epk.contactB2: Add your main social accounts — they boost credibility
epk.contactB3: Without a booking email, this section blocks conversions
epk.idWhy: Visual identity is the first thing a booker sees. A clear photo and well-defined genres drastically increase the contact rate.
epk.idB1: Upload a professional or concert profile photo
epk.idB2: Set up to 3 specific genres (e.g. "Alternative rock" over "Rock")
epk.idArtistNamePh: Your name or your band's name
epk.idGenresHint: Maximum 3 genres. Be specific — it converts better.
epk.idOriginCityHint: Where the band is from. Shown on the EPK.
epk.membersSoloLabel: Members — Not applicable for solo artists
epk.membersWhy: Bookers and venues need to know how many people and which instruments to coordinate for.
epk.membersB1: Add all members who perform live
epk.membersB2: Specify each member's main role / instrument
epk.membersB3: You can leave this empty if you're a solo act — change the formation type in Identity
epk.membersNoInstrument: Won't be shown on the EPK
epk.metricsWhy: Audience metrics are key information for promoters. You don't need big numbers — any number beats none.
epk.metricsB1: Monthly Spotify listeners: available in your Spotify for Artists
epk.metricsB2: Instagram and TikTok followers are most relevant to bookers
epk.metricsB3: You can update these numbers anytime
epk.photosTip0: Photos are the most important element of your EPK. Bookers decide in seconds based on images. Add at least 3 good-quality photos.
epk.photosTipFew: You have {count} photo. With 3 or more your EPK looks considerably more professional.
epk.photosTipFewPlural: You have {count} photos. With 3 or more your EPK looks considerably more professional.
epk.photosErrSize: The image must not exceed 10 MB.
epk.photosWhy: Photos are the first visual filter for bookers. Without images, your EPK looks incomplete and unprofessional.
epk.photosB2: Include one press photo (clean background) and one live photo
epk.photosFooter: {count}/8 photos · JPG, PNG, or WebP · max. 10 MB · Tap to change type (press/live)
epk.pressWhy: Press quotes lend enormous credibility. You don't have to be famous — a blog review or venue testimonial works perfectly.
epk.pressB1: Been reviewed by a blog, magazine, or outlet? Add it.
epk.pressB2: Testimonials from promoters or venues count too
epk.pressB3: Maximum 5 quotes — pick the most impactful ones
epk.pressQuotePh: "Their performance was one of the most memorable of the festival…"
epk.releasesWhy: Your discography shows your track record and activity as an artist. Even singles demonstrate professionalism.
epk.releasesB1: Add your most recent releases first
epk.releasesB2: Include the streaming link, even if it's just Spotify
epk.releasesB3: Cover art makes your EPK much more visual and appealing
epk.showsTipFew: With 3 or more shows your history already starts to look solid.
epk.showsWhy: Show history conveys the most credibility to a booker. Real evidence that you already play venues.
epk.showsB2: Include at least one festival if you have one — it stands out visually
epk.showsB3: You can add shows from several years ago — track record matters
epk.showsNotesPh: Headliner · Opened for X · Sold out
epk.techWhy: This is the first thing a venue or promoter asks. Filling it out avoids unnecessary back-and-forth emails.
epk.techB1: State your base fee — helps filter out unviable requests
epk.techB2: Set duration and setup time are essential for production
epk.techB3: If you bring your own PA, mention it — it's a big advantage
epk.techNotDiscoverable: Your profile will only be visible via direct link.
epk.terrWhy: Indicate which territories you're available to play in. Helps bookers know if it's worth reaching out.
epk.terrB1: Select all the territories where you accept shows
epk.videoUrlError: Invalid URL. Use a YouTube or Vimeo link.
epk.videoWhy: A good-quality live video is worth more than a thousand words to a booker.
epk.videoB1: Use YouTube or Vimeo — both platforms embed in the EPK
epk.videoB2: Ideal: a recent set or a professional 3–5 minute clip
epk.videoB3: If you don't have your own video, you can link a fan-recorded concert video
epk.videoUrlHintOk: YouTube or Vimeo. It will be embedded in your public EPK.
epk.videoUrlHintErr: ⚠ URL not recognized — use youtube.com, youtu.be, or vimeo.com

landing.heroBeta: Open Beta · Platform for live musicians
landing.heroBody: Professional EPK, 11-step rider wizard, visual stage plot and direct booking — all in one link with PIN access. Built for artists who take their show seriously.
landing.heroSocialProof: More than {n} artists already use GigBridge
landing.feat01desc: Bio, cover, links to Spotify and YouTube, real-time availability status, gallery and contact — all in a link you can share with any promoter.
landing.feat02desc: Stage, electrical, FOH audio, input list, monitors, backline, stage plot, lighting, catering and conditions. Editorial PDF with 5 available layouts.
landing.feat03desc: Protect your rider with a 4-digit PIN. Only who you decide can access the technical specs. 4-hour session, managed from the dashboard.
landing.feat04desc: Drag & drop editor with formation presets. Percentage-based positioning adaptable to any screen. Export to PDF along with the full rider.
landing.feat05desc: Venues contact you through a public form linked to your profile. Manage requests with statuses: pending, approved, rejected. Real-time notifications.
landing.feat06desc: Profile views, booking funnel, traffic sources and upcoming shows. Export everything to CSV in one click for your own analysis.
landing.howH2: In 10 minutes you have your EPK
landing.how01desc: Choose your custom slug, add bio, photo, city and links to your music. Your EPK is available at gigbridge.app/your-name
landing.how02desc: Use the 11-step wizard to document every requirement. The system generates an editorial PDF ready to send to sound and production.
landing.how03desc: Activate the rider with a private PIN. Share the link with the venue — they access it without creating an account. You decide who sees your specs.
landing.ctaBody: Sign up for free and have your EPK online in less than 10 minutes. Generate your first rider before the day is over.
landing.ctaFootnote: GIGBRIDGE.APP · BUILT FOR LIVE MUSIC · OPEN BETA
landing.footDesc: Platform for artists and bands who take their show seriously. Riders, EPK and booking in one place.

beta.metaDescription: You have been selected for the GigBridge private beta. The platform that connects musicians and venues directly.
beta.ogDescription: Free early access. EPK, rider, stage plot, direct booking and more.
beta.letterP1: You've been selected to be part of something we're building from inside the music industry: GigBridge, the platform that connects musicians and venues directly, transparently, and without intermediaries.
beta.letterP2: Before opening it to the world, we want you to be the first to try it. Your experience and feedback will shape the final product.
beta.letterP3: As a beta tester you'll get full, free access to all of the platform's tools during this phase:
beta.feat1Desc: Share your profile with one link
beta.letterP4: This invitation is personal. Your account is created in seconds and your first rider can be ready in under five minutes. No credit card required.
beta.letterP5: The GigBridge team will be available to answer any questions throughout the beta phase. Welcome to the founding team.
beta.ctaLogin: I already have an account, log in
beta.privacyNote: Your data will never be shared. You can delete your account at any time.
